title: Why Farmers Can't Legally Replant Their Own Seeds
summary: Veritasium's long documentary on the history of Monsanto's herbicides, including glyphosate, and how patented seeds prevent farmers from replanting. It covers agricultural chemistry, litigation and corporate practices.
why: Pointed to as a relevant, recent deep dive whenever Monsanto, GMO seeds or glyphosate safety come up.

quote.text: Veritasium has a couple months old video that talks about this issue
